symptoms: Long brown water-soaked stripes between veins on foliage
Dead hearts and excessive profuse tillering without productive panicles.
management: Foliar spray of Azadirachtin 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L at 14 and 28 days.

healthy_signs: Vigorous upright tillering with uniform emerald-green foliage
Sturdy culms free from lodging or fungal discoloration
Clean leaf sheaths and fully emerged, well-filled panicles/cobs
Healthy fibrous root system without rotting or browning
management: Drain standing water upon initial detection of root or sheath disease
Apply university-recommended biocontrol or registered fungicide early in the morning
Balance fertilizer regime by supplementing muriate of potash to strengthen culms
prevention: Use certified disease-free, high-germination seed lots treated with Trichoderma @ 4g/kg
Maintain optimal plant spacing to allow adequate ventilation and reduce canopy humidity
Avoid excessive nitrogen application; apply balanced NPK with silicon and zinc
Practice timely field drainage and weed sanitation around bunds
